title: Life, the Universe and Everything
author: Douglas Adams
summary: The third Hitchhiker's book. Arthur Dent and Ford Prefect, stranded on prehistoric Earth, are pulled into an effort to stop a galaxy-wide menace. It is absurd, short and full of jokes about science and bureaucracy.
readIf: you like absurd science-fiction comedy and are already a fan of the series.
skipIf: you haven't read the first two books, because the jokes build on their setup.

pairings.reason: Another witty, satirical comic fantasy that pokes fun at its own genre.
A comedy about the end of the world, with similar English dry humour and cosmic scale.
A newer science-fiction comedy that turns genre conventions inside out.
